subtitle: Lesson 19 · Terraform Workspaces & Environments

code:
# dev.tfvars
environment    = "dev"
instance_count = 1
vm_size        = "Standard_B1s"

# prod.tfvars
environment    = "prod"
instance_count = 4
vm_size        = "Standard_D4s_v3"
caption: Same variable names declared once in variables.tf — completely different values per file.
Explicit on the command line — visible in the pipeline definition, not buried in a workspace.
dev.tfvars: 1 small VM. prod.tfvars: 4 large VMs. Same module, same main.tf, different inputs.
